title: Soil unknown, no irrigation, Dobrogea, mid-September
rationale: Soil is unknown, so nothing is excluded on soil and lowData caps confidence at medium. The one ordering that survives is the water one: secara has drought_tolerance ridicata, rapita_toamna scazuta, the parcel is dryland, Cobadin shows 2 drought-flagged years in 10 and a -8.4 mm last-month precipitation anomaly, and rapița's first critical period is September-October establishment. rapița is not excluded: its southern window (09-05 → 09-15) is still open on the case date and Dobrogea's 552 mm annual normal clears its 450 mm season need.
